senses.gloss: (transpos. of מלמל, v. מִלֵּל; cmp. גִּעְגֵּעַ) to talk against, murmur, sneer.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 6:1">Pesik. R. s. 6</cite> <he>עיד לא לי׳ אדם וכ׳</he> no longer did any one talk behind Moses.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 6:1">Ib.</cite> <he>מְלַמְלְמִין</he> (not <he>מלמלאין</he>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 184">Yalk. Kings 184</cite>; (<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 52">Ex. R. s. 52</cite> <he>מליצים</he>).

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 8:8:1">Koh. R. to VIII, 8</cite> <he>מְמַלְמְלִין בפיהם וכ׳</he> (fr. <cite ref="M01603"><he>מִלְמֵל</he></cite>); Lam. R. introd. (R. Ḥān. 1) <he>מְמַלְּלִים</he> sneering with their mouths; v. <cite ref="Q01744"><he>פָּרַז</he></cite>
